conrad_brooks.text: {"ops":[{"target":"graph","s":"Conrad Brooks","p":"born","o":"January 3, 1931","quote":"Conrad Brooks (born Conrad Biedrzycki on January 3, 1931 in Baltimore, Maryland) is an American actor."},{"target":"graph","s":"Conrad Brooks","p":"moved","o":"Hollywood, California","quote":"He moved to Hollywood, California in 1948 to pursue a career in acting."},{"target":"graph","s":"Conrad Brooks","p":"got","o":"start","s_type":"film","o_type":"Ed Wood","quote":"He got his start in movies appearing in Ed Wood films such as \"Plan 9 from Outer Space\", \"Glen or Glenda\", and \"Jail Bait.\""},{"target":"graph","s":"Conrad Brooks","p":"took","o":"break","s_type":"acting","o_type":"1960s","quote":"He took a break from acting during the 1960s and 1970s but due to the ongoing interest in the films of Ed Wood, he reemerged in the 1980s and has become a prolific actor."},{"target":"graph","s":"Conrad Brooks","p":"reemerged","o":"1980s","quote":"He took a break from acting during the 1960s and 1970s but due to the ongoing interest in the films of Ed Wood, he reemerged in the 1980s and has become a prolific actor."},{"target":"graph","s":"Conrad Brooks","p":"has","o":"become","o_type":"prolific","quote":"He took a break from acting during the 1960s and 1970s but due to the ongoing interest in the films of Ed Wood, he reemerged in the 1980s and has become a prolific actor."},{"target":"graph","s":"Conrad Brooks","p":"has","o":"gone","o_type":"on","quote":"He also has since gone on to write, produce and direct several films."}]}
